rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential read resolves repo, Claude, self-report, window, and unloaded slice from chunk 0 or earlier named chunks; session-artifact references are covered by the exercise carve-out.
No body callback identifies another file or slide by position; prompts and artifacts are named directly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No fixed 'the X you did/saw' module-beat reference appears in the body; the session artifacts are live exercise artifacts.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal demo construction is present.
All six chunks contain a concrete action, explanation, or synthesis claim; the closer names the unloaded slice rather than waiting for output.
Each exercise heading accurately states the action or synthesis delivered by its chunk.
All six sub-items checked; the maintained working-prior number is explicitly attested in the source and no other banned cadence shape appears.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo-internal dialect is used as student vocabulary; context window, self-report, and status line are concrete terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold appears only in short handles/callout chrome documented by the exercise's standing emphasis note; no narrative bold monoculture remains.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This shared exercise is inlined under a phase--exercise wrapper; the layout test suite passed 24/24.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No numbered Phase/Step header or in-body ordinal reference; per-file numbering check exited 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/exercises/orient-and-introspect.md` exited 0 with no page-geometry pointers.
